CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_staff_abort_private.source_v1(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare m public.master_v2_sessions; sc mission_generic_owner.start_claims;
 bs mission_generic_owner.board_starts; q jsonb; uid uuid:=auth.uid(); users uuid[];
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'STAFF_ABORT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select * into m from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session;
 if m.id is null or m.tipo<>'quest' or m.owner_kind<>'ai_service' or m.master_user is not null
 or not combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(m.location_id,array[uid],false)
 then raise exception 'STAFF_ABORT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select array_agg(mp.user_id_snapshot order by mp.character_id) into users
 from public.master_v2_participants mp join public.characters c on c.id=mp.character_id and c.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
 where mp.session_id=m.id;
 if cardinality(users) is null or cardinality(users) not between 1 and 4
 or exists(select 1 from unnest(users) u where not combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(m.location_id,array[u],false))
 or cardinality(users)<>(select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants where session_id=m.id)
 then raise exception 'STAFF_ABORT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' using errcode='42501';end if;
 IF p_session='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid
 AND m.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
 AND uid IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=uid AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 AND cardinality(users)=2 AND users @> ARRAY['f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid]
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions f WHERE f.master_session_id=m.id AND f.enabled)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.start_claims existing_start WHERE existing_start.session_id=m.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources WHERE session_id=m.id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.run_bindings rb WHERE rb.master_session_id=m.id AND rb.snapshot_sha256='49817335c60ce9d4b47bc5d81c6950f622635c7fb232264ab54736349124f567' AND rb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(rb.snapshot))
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('kind','flow','source_schema','c1264-protected-flow-cleanup/1','binding_sha256','49817335c60ce9d4b47bc5d81c6950f622635c7fb232264ab54736349124f567');END IF;
 select * into sc from mission_generic_owner.start_claims where session_id=m.id;
 if found then
  select * into bs from mission_generic_owner.board_starts where master_session_id=m.id;
  if sc.actor_user_id<>uid or not sc.simulation or sc.state<>'bound'
  or sc.mission_id is distinct from m.mission_id or sc.location_id<>m.location_id
  or bs.id is null or not bs.simulation or bs.request_key<>sc.request_key
  or bs.snapshot_sha256<>mission_internal.fingerprint(bs.snapshot)
  or not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources ss
    join mission_ai_board_owner.activations a on a.id=bs.activation_id and a.mission_id=ss.carrier_mission_id
    join mission_ai_service_owner.capabilities cap on cap.id=bs.capability_id and cap.master_session_id=m.id
      and cap.board_activation_id=a.id and cap.start_request_key=sc.request_key
    where ss.carrier_mission_id=m.mission_id and a.current_session_id=m.id)
  then raise exception 'STAFF_ABORT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('kind','generic','activation_id',bs.activation_id,'capability_id',bs.capability_id);
 end if;
 if to_regclass('mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources') is not null
 and exists(select 1 from mission_staff_abort_private.quest_preparers p where p.master_session_id=m.id and p.actor_user_id=uid)
 then
  execute 'select to_jsonb(q) from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q
   join public.mission_run_state r on r.master_session_id=q.session_id and r.source_kind=''quest''
    and r.quest_episode_id=q.episode_id and r.quest_arc_id=q.arc_id and r.plan_version_id=q.plan_version_id and r.plan_sha256=q.plan_sha256
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=q.session_id and b.definition_id=q.definition_id
    and b.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(b.snapshot)
    and b.snapshot=mission_factory_owner.quest_binding_projection_v1(q)
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_episodes e on e.id=q.episode_id and e.arc_id=q.arc_id
    and e.source_sha256=q.source_sha256 and e.ordinal=q.episode_ordinal and e.member_character_ids=q.roster_character_ids
   where q.session_id=$1 and q.roster_snapshot_sha256=mission_factory_owner.sha(to_jsonb(q.roster_character_ids))' into q using m.id;
  if q is null or q->>'location_id'<>m.location_id::text or m.mission_id is not null
  or not exists(select 1 from mission_staff_abort_private.quest_preparers p
    where p.master_session_id=m.id and p.prepare_request_key=(q->>'prepare_request_key')::uuid)
  then raise exception 'STAFF_ABORT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' using errcode='42501';end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('kind','quest','source_control_version',(q->>'control_version')::bigint,
   'source_state',q->>'state','episode_id',q->>'episode_id');
 end if;
 raise exception 'STAFF_ABORT_NOT_AUTHORIZED' using errcode='42501';
end $function$
